title: TabPFN-3.5: Technical Report (arXiv abstract page)
note: Abstract: new flagship tabular foundation model from Prior Labs; says gains carry over to task-specific harnesses including stronger time-series forecasting. No forecasting number, covariate or load statement in the abstract. v1 2026-09-15, v3 2026-11-03. Variants Fast (up to 3x faster than TabPFN-3), Plus, Thinking.

title: TabPFN-3.5: Technical Report (v3 full text)
note: Appendix C.6: on fev-bench (100 tasks, 29 methods, skill over Seasonal Naive on SQL and MASE) the general TabPFN-3.5 checkpoint run through tabpfn-time-series, with no time-series fine-tuning, places sixth, 1.1 points above TabPFN-TS-3 at 2.4x its speed, behind TimesFM-3, two Chronos-2 variants, TiRex-2 and Toto-2.0. Exact scores, horizons and covariate use not read.

title: TabPFN-3.5: Technical Report (v3 full text)
note: Section 4: weights for TabPFN-3.5 and 3.5-Fast are on Hugging Face (Prior-Labs/tabpfn_3_5) under the TabPFN-3.5 License v1.0, which allows research and evaluation but not commercial or production use; code is Apache-2.0. Training follows the TabPFN-3 synthetic prior. Inference timings are on one 96 GB GPU; the managed API is recommended for users without a GPU.

title: PriorLabs/tabpfn-time-series README
note: v1.3.0 (2026-09-15) makes TabPFN-3.5 the default in local and client modes (needs tabpfn 9.0.0 or later); the fine-tuned TabPFN-TS-3 checkpoint stays available. Known future covariates are supported and numeric ones get lag and trailing-mean features; past and static covariates are dropped. Cloud client is the default; local mode needs licence acceptance. Code Apache-2.0.

title: PriorLabs/tabpfn-time-series README
note: Claim: on the 25 fev-bench tasks with numeric known covariates, the known-covariate lag features lower SQL by 4.5% with the v3.5 model; 21 of 25 tasks improve and the worst task is 1.5% worse. This compares the same model with and without the features, not against another model. No test-window length or interval given.

title: Prior-Labs/tabpfn_3_5 model card
note: Licence tabpfn-3-5-license-v1.0: testing, evaluation and internal benchmarking allowed; no commercial or production use of the model, derivatives or outputs. Trained only on synthetic tabular tasks. Checkpoints tabpfn-v3.5-20260909.safetensors (default), a Fast and an experimental multiclass file. Card covers tabular regression and classification; no forecasting statement, no hardware requirement.
